name: rose-griffon
description: Rose Griffon monorepo orchestrator. Exposes grok (xAI Grok Build) and agy (Antigravity / Google Cloud Code) as A2A subagent peers, routed by Claude Code over a file-based A2A coord protocol (this Agent Card + .coord/*.jsonl mailboxes).

skills.name: grok code task
skills.description: Run a coding / refactor / analysis task on the Grok Build model and return its final answer. Headless, JSON-parsed.
examples: Refactor this module to remove duplication
Write a Bun test for tools/llm-agents/llm.ts

skills.name: agy reasoning task
skills.description: Run a broad reasoning / generation task on the Antigravity (Gemini / Cloud Code) backend and return its plain-text answer. Headless print mode.
examples: Draft an architecture doc for the menu pipeline
Review this design and list risks
Summarize the tradeoffs between two approaches

skills.name: route a task to a peer
skills.description: Write an A2A envelope (kind=ask) to a peer inbox in the .coord mailbox and read its ack — the file-based routing primitive of this orchestrator.
examples: Route this refactor to grok and await its ack
Broadcast a fact to all peers

_aphrody.comment: Compat dialecte aphrody (aphrody doctor / a2a-ui). Les champs canoniques A2A v1.0.1 sont au niveau racine ci-dessus.

_peers.description: Claude Code — decomposes tasks and routes sub-tasks to grok/agy, then merges results.
xAI Grok Build CLI (logged in via grok.com). Fast, JSON output, codegen + self-verify (--check).
Antigravity CLI (fork Codeium/Windsurf -> Google Cloud Code). Plain-text, large context, slower.

envelope.format: append-only JSONL, one envelope per line, ISO-8601 UTC ts, // comment lines ignored

_coord.note: Compatible aphrody a2a-ui::Envelope (v1, flat) + duel-loop. Spec canonique clonée: tools/llm-agents/reference/A2A (v1.0.1).
